LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.0.label: Take the Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.0.description: Retains the chosen Blade evolution. Refinement: its bonus damage. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.1.label: Held Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.1.description: Three ordinary hits within 2 cells on the same enemy leave an edge mark for 5 seconds, on at most one victim. Cooldown: 3 seconds. A different eligible target or a 4-second gap resets the count. Distant hits, bonus damage and abilities do not count. Refinement: edge mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.2.label: Crossed Blades
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.2.description: Ordinary hits within 2 cells on two different enemies within 4 seconds grant you a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds. Repeating the same target neither advances nor renews the count. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.3.label: Closing Cut
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.3.description: A Blade ability hit spends the victim’s edge mark for 75 extra damage, at most once per second per victim. Later pulses add nothing without a new mark. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.4.label: Feint
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.4.description: A close ordinary hit spends the enemy’s edge mark and records both positions for 3 seconds. Walk across the dividing line through the recorded target cell, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells on that enemy for 50 extra damage. Standing on the line does not count; target movement does not shift it. Teleporting cancels the opportunity. Once per edge mark; a new opportunity replaces the old one. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.5.label: Back of the Blade
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.5.description: After Crossed Blades absorbs enemy damage, remember the latest attacker for 3 seconds. An ordinary hit within 2 cells returns the latest hit’s absorbed amount, up to 50 damage, once per shield round. Later blocks replace the attacker and damage budget without extending the original 3-second window. Refinement: return-damage cap. Actual absorption is not multiplied. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.6.label: Blades Together
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.6.description: Within 3 seconds after Crossed Blades grants its shield, the next ordinary hit within 2 cells marks an enemy for 3 seconds. A different player colonist who lands an ordinary hit on that enemy gains a shield with a base amount of 1 for 3 seconds, once per round. The author cannot claim it. A new Crossed Blades grant replaces an unfinished round. Refinement: shield strength. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.7.label: Returning Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.7.description: Real Closing Cut damage opens a 4-second target-switch opportunity. An ordinary hit within 2 cells on another enemy gives it a 5-second edge mark, once per round. Only one marked target is retained; the new mark replaces the old one without resetting Held Edge count or cooldown. Refinement: edge mark duration. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: mark duration ×1.5.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.8.label: Flanking Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.8.description: Real Feint damage remembers its enemy for 30 seconds. The next Blade ability hit on that enemy adds 50 damage and consumes the opportunity. Losing the target does not transfer the reward. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.9.label: Fight On
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.9.description: Real Back of the Blade damage opens a 3-second opportunity. Walk at least one step, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells on the original attacker to heal your non-permanent injuries once, with a base amount of 1 affected by healing modifiers. Full health preserves the original deadline without spending the opportunity. Teleporting cancels it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.10.label: Pincer
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.10.description: After the ally shield from Blades Together actually absorbs enemy damage, a close ordinary hit by the author on the original marked enemy adds 50 damage within 3 seconds, once. Only that ally’s exact shield layer counts. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.11.label: Guarded Return
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.11.description: When Closing Cut spends the mark transferred by Returning Edge and deals damage, grant yourself a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per transferred mark. Ordinary Held Edge marks do not qualify. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.12.label: Passing Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.12.description: After Closing Cut spends a transferred edge mark and deals damage, take at least two walking steps with a net displacement of 2 cells, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells on another enemy within 3 seconds for 50 damage, once per mark. Passing Edge itself generates no new mark. Teleporting cancels the opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.13.label: Pursuing Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.13.description: Real Flanking Edge damage records its victim’s position for 3 seconds. Take a real walking step outside 2 cells of that position, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells on a different enemy for 50 damage, once. The original victim moving does not move the area. Teleporting cancels the opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.14.label: Hidden Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.14.description: After Flanking Edge deals damage, grant the nearest other colonist within 3 cells a shield with a base amount of 2 for 3 seconds. With no ally, grant yourself a base amount of 1 instead, once per round. Later pulses do not grant another shield. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 25/50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.15.label: Cover the Opening
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.15.description: After Fight On actually heals, grant yourself a separate shield with a base amount of 2 for 3 seconds, once per round. This layer cannot restart Back of the Blade. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.16.label: Change Hands
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.16.description: Real Fight On healing opens a 3-second target-switch opportunity. An ordinary hit within 2 cells on a different enemy heals the most injured other colonist within 4 cells once, with a base amount of 1 affected by healing modifiers. With no eligible patient, the original deadline is retained, not renewed. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.17.label: Closing Pincer
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.17.description: After Pincer deals damage, grant its original Blades Together ally a new 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per round. This layer cannot restart Pincer. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.18.label: Change Wings
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Blade.nodes.18.description: After Pincer deals damage, remember the original ally’s position for 3 seconds. Take a real walking step outside 2 cells of that fixed position, then land an ordinary hit within 2 cells on a different enemy to heal the most injured other colonist within 4 cells, with a base amount of 1. Excludes yourself and the original ally; once per round. With no patient, retain the original deadline without spending the opportunity. Teleporting cancels it. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
